description: Get a snapshot of the quantum computing landscape — no parameters needed. Use when the user asks broad questions like "how's the quantum job market?", "what are trending topics?", or wants an overview of the quantum computing industry. Returns: total active jobs, top hiring companies, jobs by role type, papers published this week, total researchers tracked, and trending technology tags. For specific job/paper/researcher searches, use the dedicated search tools instead.
name: getMarketOverview
title: Quantum Market Overview
